Indicator: Always/often handwashing with soap and water after returning home from a public place
Note: Question: “In the past seven days, how often did you wash your hands with soap and water straight away after returning home from a public place?”; base for percentage: adults who left their home in the past seven days.

Indicator: Used a face covering when outside their home
Note: Question “In the past seven days, have you used a face covering when outside your home to help slow the spread of the coronavirus (COVID-19)?”; base for percentage: adults who left their home in the past seven days.

Indicator: Always/often maintaining social distancing when meeting up with people outside their support bubble
Note: Question: “In the past seven days, when you have met up with people outside of your support bubble, how often have you maintained social distancing?”; base for percentage: adults who met up with people indoors or outdoors, outside of their support bubble or household.

Indicator: Avoiding physical contact when outside their home
Note: Question: “Examples of direct physical contact may include shaking or holding hands, hugging and making contact when passing objects. In the past seven days, have you avoided physical contact with others when outside your home?”; base for percentage: adults who left their home in the past seven days.

Question: “Self-isolation is defined as staying at home because you have symptoms or have been in contact with someone who has symptoms or has tested positive for the coronavirus (COVID-19). In the past seven days, have you self-isolated because of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic?”; base for percentage: all adults.

Indicator: Stayed at home or only left for work, exercise, essential shopping or medical needs
Note: This series was originally reported during the first national lockdown as a proxy for adherence to "stay at home" measures. We continue to report these estimates as an indication of individuals' activity outside of the household. Questions: "In the past seven days, have you left your home for any reason?" and "In the past seven days, for what reasons have you left your home?"; base for percentage: all adults.

Indicator: Working adults that have worked from home
Note: Question: “In the past seven days, have you worked from home because of the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic?”; base for percentage: working adults. This definition is different to some other surveys and is included in the Glossary section.

Indicator: Working adults travelling to work (exclusively and in combination with working from home)
Note: Question: “In the past seven days, for what reasons have you left your home?”; base for percentage: working adults. This definition is different to some other surveys and is included in the Glossary section.

Indicator: Very or somewhat worried about the effect of COVID-19 on their life right now
Note: Question: “How worried or unworried are you about the effect that the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic is having on your life right now?”; base for percentage: all adults.
